'''Neural probes''' were devices used by the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]]. During the hunt for [[Lord/Legends|Lord]] [[Cronal]] in [[5 ABY/Legends|5 ABY]], [[Wedge Antilles/Legends|Wedge Antilles]] used neural probes to try to extract information from the minds of Lord Cronal's minions.<ref name="Mindor">''[[Luke Skywalker and the Shadows of Mindor]]''</ref>
